In this lab you will build a local Kafka streaming pipeline using Docker Compose, consume Reddit comment data with both a plain Python consumer and a Spark Structured Streaming job, and deploy an AWS Lambda container image that automatically refreshes Athena partitions whenever new data lands in S3.

All instructions are in the lab repository linked below.
